name: Retained-Operator Coupling Law v1
purpose: Define how compact retained finite-capacity action state rho_n lawfully modifies the future transport/accessibility operator without adding a manual provenance force.

derived_coupling.dimensionless_retained_burden: r_n = P_G(rho_n / c_ref), with r_n >= 0 in admissible gauge
derived_coupling.future_linearized_operator: O_{n+1}(q)=response under d diag(a_n^eff ⊙ sigma'((a_n^eff⊙d*phi_{n+1})/c_n^eff)) d*

why_this_is_forced_minimally: Retained action can only affect future transport through admissible primitives inside RAG-0.
No coordinate, curvature, metric, target K, or future target operator can be used.
Ordered composition requires sequential retained burdens to compose associatively.
The only scalar positive compositional accessibility map with identity at zero burden and additive retained burden is exponential up to gauge/scale: m(r1+r2)=m(r1)m(r2), m(0)=1, m>=0 -> m=exp(-r).
Applying the same multiplier to a and c changes accessible transport domain while preserving the finite-capacity constitutive shape and pressure ratio.
This is the minimal coupling: retained state gates accessibility, not a new force term.

repair_extension_not_closed.reason: repair budget law must be separately derived and cannot be inserted as a free healing term

non_smuggling_guards: rho_n generated before future target scoring
m_n depends only on rho_n and fixed reference capacity gauge
coupling is multiplicative accessibility restriction, not additive force
